title: Generating Benchmark Health Data Using a Tabular Diffusion Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2608.14496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-Tabular Data Generation (CTDG) seeks to learn a generative model from multiple heterogeneous tables and produce new synthetic tabular datasets. However, existing synthetic tabular data generation methods are largely restricted to single-input-table scenarios and struggle to effectively handle multiple heterogeneous tables with diverse feature sets. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage framework for cross-tabular data generation. In the first stage, each heterogeneous raw table is transformed into a standardized statistical table with the same set of columns across all tables. Each statistical table captures the marginal distributions of the original columns and the pairwise correlations among them. In the second stage, a diffusion transformer model is trained to capture structural patterns across these homogeneous statistical tables and to generate synthetic statistical tables. translated_title: 使用表格扩散Transformer生成基准健康数据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14496v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：跨表格数据生成（CTDG）旨在从多个异构表格中学习生成模型，并产生新的合成表格数据集。然而，现有的合成表格数据生成方法主要局限于单输入表格场景，难以有效处理具有多样化特征集的多个异构表格。为解决这一限制，我们提出了一种用于跨表格数据生成的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，每个异构原始表格被转换为具有相同列集的标准统计表格。每个统计表格捕获原始列的边际分布及它们之间的成对相关性。在第二阶段，训练一个扩散变换器模型来捕获这些同质统计表格中的结构模式，并生成合成统计表格。随后，合成原始表格被生成。
tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段跨表格数据生成框架，通过将异构表格标准化为统计表格，并利用扩散变换器模型生成合成数据，以解决多表异构数据生成的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage cross-tabular data generation framework that standardizes heterogeneous tables into statistical tables and uses a diffusion transformer to generate synthetic data, addressing the challenge of multi-table heterogeneous data generation.
